messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
According to the nanoScan3 manual, at least how often must the regular thorough checks (regular tests) of the protective device be carried out?

response.text: Secondo il manuale del nanoScan3, con quale frequenza minima devono essere eseguite le verifiche regolari approfondite (test periodici) del dispositivo di protezione?
